summary: rig 0.43 で cheaper 互換 runtime が 20MB 以内に実装可能かを実測判定する
Windows x64 release binary: 7,986,176 bytes (7.62 MB), under the 20 MiB gate. lto+opt-level=s+strip+codegen-units=1, panic=unwind.
max_invalid_tool_call_retries defaults to 0: InvalidToolCallAction::Retry is silently degraded to Fail without an explicit per-run budget.

Provider failures surface as PromptError::Report(ErrorReport) carrying http_status and retryable. ProviderError::kind()/provider_response_status()/is_retryable() give the same classification; ErrorKind::Http (StreamEnded/Instance incl. timeouts) has no status and is transient.

Ollama real run (qwen3.5:4b): accumulator turns=2 toolCalls=1 usage 1155/122/1277. Scripted: unknown-tool-call Retry recovered without counting toolCalls; repair loop merged turns=2 repairs=1; abort drop gave partial snapshot; panic -> INTERNAL_ERROR exit 70, stdout unpolluted.

Review finding (confirmed): a turn rolled back by InvalidToolCallAction::Retry fires neither on_outcome nor on_model_turn_finished (rig-agent settle_model_turn). Its billed usage is only visible via on_run_settled SettledOutcome::Response.usage; accumulator reconciles to the run total. Measured: unknown-tool-call inputTokens=250 (rolled-back 100 + accepted 150).
Review finding (confirmed): denied tool dispatch resolves as Ok(ToolResult::skipped) — is_ok() alone counts skipped tools as executed. Fixed: skipped/Err outcomes count to rejectedToolCalls.

Post-review probe results: abort-probe two-turn script yields partialMeta turns=1 usage=10/2/12 (nonzero partial accounting proven); error-probe request-error->PERMANENT, transport(Http kind)->TRANSIENT_TRANSPORT, provider-error exits 75; Windows release re-measured 7,983,104 B.
